evals.name: scaffold-and-brief
evals.prompt: We're kicking off a serious design push on our pricing page. The current page is at {FIXTURES}/pricing.html — it's for Fieldnote, a note-taking app for field researchers; the audience is working scientists who hate fiddly software. I want everything set up for a world-class elevation of this page: the brief, the lab, the gates — but do NOT run any review rounds yet, I want to see the setup first.
evals.expected_output: Brief written from context, lab scaffolded with valid elevate.config.json, master honouring the state contract, both gates run (and their status reported honestly), zero panel rounds run.

evals.name: one-round-fix
evals.prompt: Our design lab at {LAB} has a locked master — a newsletter signup card for Meridian, a print magazine. Palette lock is Ink #111111, Indigo #4f46e5, White #ffffff; Geist 400/600. Run one full elevation panel round on it and fix everything that survives verification. When you're done the gates must be green and the round must be on the record.
evals.expected_output: Seven seats reviewed (blind protocol or declared degraded blindness), refuter pass ran with some findings refuted, all confirmed findings fixed and verified rendered, both gates exit 0, panel.json carries the round, report rebuilt.

evals.name: report-door
evals.prompt: Here's the panel record from our tasks design engagement: {PANEL}. The engagement is closed. Build me the session record — the one-page founder read on where it landed. Save it as session-record.html. Do not invent any numbers that aren't derivable from the record.
evals.expected_output: A self-contained session-record page whose numbers (rounds, lowest seat, findings totals) all match the panel record; honest about the gate not being met; renders clean.

evals.name: foreign-brand
evals.prompt: Set up a design-elevation engagement for a client project: Harbor & Vine, a coastal restaurant — the surface is their tasting-menu page. Their brand is NOT ours: Forest #1d3a2f, Cream #f6f2e9, Copper #b06b3c; type is Fraunces (400/600) with Inter for UI labels. The audience is diners deciding whether to book. Set up the brief, the lab and the gates — no review rounds yet.
evals.expected_output: Engagement scaffolded with the CLIENT's palette and families in elevate.config.json (not the default Ink/Indigo), brief carries their world, gates run against their lock.
